description: List the hostnames found under a domain in TLS certificates: one row per hostname with the number of certificates and first/last seen dates. Covers certificates valid now or expired within the last 90 days; set history to true for every hostname certified since 2013 (needs an API key on the Pro Lite or Pro plan). Use this to enumerate subdomains; use search_certificates for the certificates themselves.

cursor.description: The next_cursor of the previous call, to get the next page; omit for the first page

domain.description: A bare DNS name such as example.com, without a scheme, path or port

history.description: true lists every hostname certified since 2013 instead of the last 90 days; needs an API key on the Pro Lite or Pro plan

name: find_subdomains
title: Find subdomains
